label: Transition — Nomad into Village
candidates: The paths you walked last season have hardened into stone.
Where grey wanderers drifted, a settlement now stands.
The huddle you met is gone. In its place, walls.
Dirt trails you pressed with your feet now carry travelers in your color.
The people you left behind have stopped wandering and built.
The ground you walked remembers you — your trails are now paved.
A generation has passed. The nomads have chosen where to root.
What was loose earth beneath your feet is now worked stone.
